hints.title: Task Duration Tracking
hints.text: For task i, duration equals leaveTime[i] - leaveTime[i - 1] (or leaveTime[0] for the initial task).

hints.title: Maximum Duration Retention
hints.text: Track the maximum duration observed across all completed tasks.

hints.title: ID Tie Breaking
hints.text: When a task matches the maximum duration, pick the employee id with smaller numerical value.

hints.title: Single Pass Duration Scan Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def hardestWorker(self, n: int, logs: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        best_id = logs[0][0]
        max_dur = logs[0][1]
        prev_time = logs[0][1]
        
        for emp_id, leave_time in logs[1:]:
            dur = leave_time - prev_time
            if dur > max_dur or (dur == max_dur and emp_id < best_id):
                max_dur = dur
                best_id = emp_id
            prev_time = leave_time
        return best_id
```

complexity.notes: Single pass over logs array updating best employee record.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Multi-pass re-sorting by duration adds unnecessary O(m log m) overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory tracks the optimal candidate in-place.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Computes time intervals between log checkpoints and applies tie-breaking rule in linear scan.
